breakdown.description: Fanning friction factor is used directly in the Darcy–Weisbach equation without converting to Darcy friction factor.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly uses the Fanning friction factor f = 0.005 in the Darcy–Weisbach equation without converting it to the Darcy friction factor (f_D = 4 × 0.005 = 0.02). It repeats the original error by treating the Fanning friction factor as if it were the Darcy friction factor. The ground truth requires explicit conversion: f_D = 4 f_F = 0.02.
